FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE p.category_en = 'toys'

  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS active_seller_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_state = 'DF'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) AS active_sellers
FROM sellers s
WHERE s.seller_state = 'PE'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.seller_id = s.seller_id

      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-06-02 00:00:00'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01 00:00:00'
